title: Claudette: Make Claude stop talking like a BuzzFeed article
summary: Claudette (nobuzz) is a prompt engineering tool that modifies Claude's output to remove BuzzFeed-style language patterns, making AI responses more natural, professional, and less sensationalist. It addresses the common complaint that AI assistants often generate overly casual or clickbait-sounding content.
problem_solved: Prevents Claude from generating BuzzFeed-style, sensationalist, or overly casual content that feels inauthentic.
why_valuable: Improves AI output quality by making responses more professional and authentic, addressing a real pain point in AI-generated content readability.
